capabilities: Convert PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF to JPEG XL
Convert images on paste or across the vault
Verify converted files and update links
disambiguation: Not a general image editor; it only converts images to JPEG XL and renders .jxl files, and converted files open only where this plugin is installed.
extras: Runs entirely on-device with no network or telemetry. Originals are kept unless Remove originals is enabled, in which case they go to Obsidian's trash. Built with rapier-jxl and MIT-licensed. The repository also holds files that Rapier (rapier.website) and its agent plugins load.
problem: Large PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images take up vault space, and Obsidian cannot display .jxl files without help.
summary: Offline image converter that turns PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF files into smaller JPEG XL files and lets you view .jxl pictures in notes.
